verification.method: live view reads via genlayer_py (deploy time) and genlayer-js (current head)
verification.note: GenVM is not an EVM chain, so eth_getCode returns 0x even for a live contract and cannot be used to compare deployed bytecode against source. Deployment is instead evidenced by live view reads answering from this address.

observed_at_current_head.solvency_identity: total_collateral + locked_escrow + reserves + total_claimable == balance (300 + 700 + 0 + 1500 == 2500 GEN)

state_note: Used, not fresh: the autonomous agents founded Halcyon and Meridian here, proposed and settled treaties 1 and 2, and the contract holds 2500 GEN under the solvency identity above. `observed_at_deploy` records the empty state read immediately after deployment and is kept for comparison; `observed_at_current_head` is the live state. The rpc_url is the studio-dev hostname used at deploy time; studio-next.genlayer.com serves the same chain 61997 and answers identically.
